name: deMona Dating dSim
source:
A short little visual novel made for the spooky season. 

You have a crush on a demoness named Mona, and you have three dates to win her heart before the end-of-the-month Halloween party. Can you get invited? More importantly, will you be able to charm this lovely demon lady?

[From [url=https://zenithzyie.itch.io/demona-dating-dsim]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部为恐怖季节而制作的短篇视觉小说。

你迷恋上了一个名叫莫娜的恶魔，在月底的万圣节派对之前，你有三个约会机会来赢得她的芳心。你能被邀请吗？更重要的是，你能迷倒这位可爱的恶魔女士吗？

[来自[url=https://zenithzyie.itch.io/demona-dating-dsim]itch.io[/url]]
